lines.text: If you had *Gojo's Infinity,* this punch would *never* touch you.
The closer it gets, the *slower* it moves. Forever.
But your brain would track *every atom* around you, every second.
That's why Gojo needs the *Six Eyes.*
Pull the Infinity inward, and you get *Blue.*
Push it outward, and you get *Red.*
Sukuna doesn't hit you. He cuts *the space* you're standing in.
Infinity, or the Six Eyes? Comment *one* or *two.*
